business_summary: ZETTA Group Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacturing of spray paints, mechanical and automotive care products, and household care products in China and internationally. The company operates through two segments, Fine Chemicals and Photovoltaic Business. It offers spray paints, such as acrylic, animal marking, benzene-free, custom color, diy wall repair, fluorescent, cold galvanizing, hammer finish, heat resistant, line marker, metallic, second petroleum, trim and bumper, silver zinc rich compound, and water-based spray paints; spray lubricants, including anti-rust lubricant, chain lube, grease spray, mold release, penetrating oil, silicone spray, and white lithium grease. The company also provides car cleaners comprising adhesive remover, antibacterial air conditioner cleaner, brake and parts cleaner, bug and tar remover, carburetor cleaners, carpet and upholstery cleaner, foamy engine cleaner, heavy duty engine degreaser, metal polish, multipurpose foamy cleaner, parts cleaner, throttle body and air intake cleaner, and windshield cleaner. In addition, it offers car paint maintenance products; anti mist spray, anti-freeze, antibiotic leather wax, coolant boost, de-frost, ice remover, interior detailer, low temperature starting fluid, matt finish interior detailer, and tire foam car maintenance products; foam sealant, air freshener, chain cleaner, furniture polish, and metallic polish cleaner household care products; and personal care and beauty sprays. The company was formerly known as Shenzhen Sunrise New Energy Co., Ltd. and changed its name to ZETTA Group Co., Ltd. in December 2025. ZETTA Group Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Shenzhen, the People's Republic of China.
